details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_git_subprocess_env (lines 2987-2992), _inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3084) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded in HTTPS Git URLs after the per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication was removed.
  WHY: The PAT appears in Git argv, `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, diagnostics, and remote URL handling, violating the credential-free URL contract.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 140-151 and 180; _memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 578-588) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` authentication was removed, force-tick URLs embed tokens, and `memory_ensure_branch` uses unauthenticated `git ls-remote` and `git push`.
  WHY: Force-tick operations leak credentials, while workflows using `persist-credentials: false` cannot create or update `ai-memory` branches.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 143-522 (entire `model_provider_broker_*` block removed) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The shared model-provider broker API was deleted while workflows and scripts still call its functions.
  WHY: Model phases fail with `command not found` before Codex starts, and the documented credential-isolation boundary is removed.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose Codex invocation uses `--sandbox danger-full-access` without the broker and while `GH_TOKEN`, `GH_PAT`, and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` remain available.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content can cause Codex to read or exfiltrate credentials and mutate the workspace outside the previous brokered read-only boundary.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 152-167 and lines 240-247 (`normalize_path`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering for `.git`, `.ssh`, `.aws`, `.env*`, and credential files was removed.
  WHY: Untrusted issue or plan paths can resolve and inline repository credentials and Git metadata into model prompts.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 536-716 (`emit_context`) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The path-count cap and byte accounting for markers and other output were removed.
  WHY: Arbitrarily large untrusted path lists can exceed `max_bytes` and the model context budget; the severity is highest where reviewers disagreed on related bounds impact.

- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: line 63 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support rejection path posts to Telegram by embedding `TG_BOT_SECRET` in the curl URL instead of using the staged trusted helper.
  WHY: The secret is exposed in process arguments and the trusted-helper invariant is bypassed.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 766-772, 833-839, 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: PR comment transforms no longer emit `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval logic cannot bind producer identity or validate trusted approver type and association.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage line 7, lines 49-54, lines 165-462 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and isolated process-group supervision were removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit on an unknown option, and descendant kill/survivor verification is lost.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 29-35, 85-90, 95-100, 105-110, 143-148, 258-264 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed and `base_url` was hard-coded to `"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` while callers still pass the broker URL.
  WHY: Broker-routed configuration exits with `unknown argument` or bypasses the loopback broker.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 52-138 (`codex_config_assemble`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `codex_config_assemble` no longer parses or forwards `--provider-base-url`.
  WHY: Existing callers fail before configuration is written.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: line 493-498 and lines 947-1352 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the `review_blocked_*` helper family were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes and review-blocked approval, successor, marker, and terminal-decision paths fail with missing functions.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-82 and downstream memory-helper steps | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication exports are scoped to one step and are not available to later `memory_ensure_branch` calls.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, later `git ls-remote` and `git push` operations fail or silently fail open.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 98-237 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore/rebase block is gated on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but no workflow exports them.
  WHY: The protection against self-repo support-file overwrite remains inactive.

- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: lines 8-73 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The handler reads `SSB_REASON` and `SSB_FILES`, while the commit script writes different names to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`.
  WHY: Staged-support conflicts do not reach the intended `ai:needs-human` latch.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 30 and 37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests import the removed `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError`.

- tests/test_model_provider_broker.py: lines 350-353, 385-405, 458-465 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Broker tests still source and invoke the deleted broker functions.
  WHY: The tests fail with missing commands or broker-content assertion failures.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 184-186 (`git merge-file` invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `git merge-file` passes editor/support-baseline/HEAD in an order claimed to use the wrong common base.
  WHY: The three-way merge may drop or incorrectly reapply branch changes; moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly verified this claim as false.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 184-186 (`git merge-file` invocation, return code path) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The merge-file return code handling is claimed to misclassify errors and allow invalid merged output.
  WHY: Conflict and tool-error paths may be treated incorrectly; moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly verified this claim as false.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 95-104 and 146-149 (`patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose configuration is written to `${HOME:-/root}/.codex/config.toml` instead of `CODEX_HOME`.
  WHY: Reasoning settings can persist in the runner home and miss the broker-isolated configuration directory.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 331-351, 367-462 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The simplified kill path can stop tracking the process group when the child exits before `nobody` descendants.
  WHY: Editor grandchildren may survive stall termination and retain resources or workspace state.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 130-156 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A missing `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` is treated as a staged-support conflict even for consumer repositories where no ledger is expected.
  WHY: Consumer implement runs can fail closed with a misleading conflict diagnosis.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 568-579 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Overflowing paths still trigger Semble subprocess calls after the overflow budget should have been exhausted.
  WHY: Large path lists incur repeated subprocess latency.

- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: lines 41-50 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Failed or empty label verification leaves latch state unknown while the handler exits and posts a warning.
  WHY: A transient `gh issue view` failure may leave the issue unlatched and eligible for redispatch.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 732-738, 793-799 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Documentation still describes comment payload fields that the transforms no longer emit.
  WHY: Consumers receive a schema inconsistent with the documented contract.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Pin `astral-sh/setup-uv` and `jlumbroso/free-disk-space` actions to reviewed full commit SHAs."
  expected_change_site: All `.github/workflows/*.yml` Semble-bootstrap steps and the `review_autofix.yml` free-disk-space step
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Present and verified done: all `astral-sh/setup-uv@v7` references use `37802adc94f370d6bfd71619e3f0bf239e1f3b78`; `jlumbroso/free-disk-space@v1.3.1` uses `54081f138730dfa15788a46383842cd2f914a1be`; audit coverage was added.

- requirement: "Resolve support exclusively from validated `job.workflow_sha`, reject mutable fallbacks, and fail closed when the immutable checkout is unavailable."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` step "Fetch memory helper scripts"
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Immutable checkout and validation are present, but downstream memory Git authentication is absent or uses URL-embedded tokens: `_memory_git` and `_git_subprocess_env` authentication were removed, and later memory operations are not authenticated.

- requirement: "Load `tg_helpers.sh` only from validated `job.workflow_sha` and remove the mutable `main` fallback."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` steps "Send PR merged Telegram alert" and "Cleanup tracked Telegram messages"
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The `issue_pr_status.yml` paths validate and compare the staged helper, but `scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh` still posts directly to Telegram at line 63.

- requirement: The mitigation policy requires "an automated, deterministic control" and forbids operator-run commands or manual sign-off unless the recommendation starts with `HUMAN GATE REQUIRED:`.
  expected_change_site: T
